about: Side quests, written like main_quest.json chapters but with no relic. A step is words (done by talking to someone) or {"text", "goal", "to"} (done by itself). Rewards: gold, arrows, sun_ore, shard, sigil.

lost_hound.title: The Hound Who Would Not Come Home

steps.text: Find Wren's hound, Ash, somewhere in the Weepingwold
Bring word to Wren in Emberhold
Carry 3 Sun Ore up from the deep places
Bring the ore to Garrick Ashhand
Thin the frost wolves of the Wintermarch (5)
